vector_native_baseline.source: Fixed-run raw Vector retrieval, retained unchanged by the final/initial refresh.

provenance.nonreportable_reason: SRA_GATEDROUTER_ALLOW_SOURCE_DRIFT=1 and final audit disabled; development run is nonreportable; runtime_judgment_lookup_cache enabled, so repeated judgments may skip exact request reconstruction
provenance.input_map_caveat: Unchanged input_runs.json still names the older Vector RouterBSI run. The bound CSV-refresh receipt overrides that stale map for Vector RouterBSI and RouterBSI_init only.
provenance.comparison_caveat: Archived candidate rankings are retained; this is not a controlled shared-candidate comparison.

selection: Dataset=Average; equal-weight arithmetic mean across BM25, Vector, and SkillSight for each method/cutoff; native baseline plus five named routing methods; no initialization curve or model-specific panel.
aggregation: For each method and retriever, calculate 100 * Recall@k / Recall@50; then take the equal-weight mean across BM25, Vector, and SkillSight.
